role: Defines two Protocol (structural subtyping) contracts for knowledge graph and behavioral data persistence backends.
detail: GraphPersistence (runtime_checkable Protocol) defines the persistence interface for the knowledge graph: node/edge CRUD (save_node, get_node, delete_node, save_edge, get_edge, delete_edge), structured queries (query_nodes, query_edges), embedding similarity search (find_similar_nodes, find_nodes_by_embedding with default min_similarity=0.7, threshold=0.8, limit=10), temporal window queries, schema evolution (apply_type_split), expectation management (get/save_property_expectation), similarity clustering (get_similar_to_cluster with contrast_ratio calculation), Epic 5 lookups (get_schema_proposal, get_instance_type), primitive symbol operations (save/get_primitive_symbol, get_all_primitive_symbols), grounding failure tracking (save/get/mark_grounding_failures_processed), health_check, and close. BehavioralStore (runtime_checkable Protocol) defines the persistence interface for behavioral data (not the knowledge graph): proposal outcomes (save/get_recent_proposal_outcomes, limit=20), correction events (save/get_open_correction_events), verification results (save/get_verification_results_for_correction), gap lifecycle events (save/get_gap_lifecycle_history), session summaries (save/get_recent_session_summaries, limit=10), and behavioral baselines (save/get_behavioral_baseline). All methods are async. Both protocols use structural subtyping (@runtime_checkable) to avoid inheritance coupling, allowing Neo4j/in-memory/TimescaleDB backends to satisfy the contract without explicit inheritance. No shared implementation code. Layer 3 (Knowledge) domain contracts injected at composition root.
gotchas: Referential integrity not enforced at protocol level (save_edge allows edges to dangling nodes). SIMILAR_TO edges stored directed but considered bidirectional during clustering. Primitive symbols and grounding failures are separate Neo4j labels from the three-level schema. Behavioral store records are append-only in normal operation; upsert semantics specified for idempotence. No validation of node existence in save_edge. apply_type_split is complex atomic operation with 7-step sequence including edge creation and node status updates.
